parsed.rationale: Three types — `Announcement`, `Breakpoint`, and `Talkset` — all in the `Playlist` package share an exactly identical initializer signature `init(id:hour:chronOrderID:timeCreated:)`. Because all three are in the same package and none carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, this is production duplication that can be eliminated. The idiomatic Swift approach is to introduce (or extend an existing) protocol `PlaylistEntry` with a default implementation of this initializer in a protocol extension, removing the boilerplate from each conforming type. The file naming convention (`_Plant_Announcement.swift`) suggests these types are already conceptually related plant/entry types sharing a common shape.
